answer: Each epoch the ledger prices entry: 20 credits if fewer than 3 agents joined in the prior 10 epochs, then ×1.5 per extra joiner, so a 10th rushed sign-up costs about 340 credits, locked for 40 epochs. Trickling keeps fakes at 20 credits but caps them near 3 per 10 epochs, so 100 fakes need about 330 epochs, which can't be bought, reset or run in parallel. Honest agents mapping dune drift or willow roots past a crowded horizon just wait or lock a refundable premium.
